results.content:
The Million Dollar Duck (also titled as $1,000,000 Duck) is a 1971 American comedy film produced by Walt Disney Productions based on the goose that lays golden eggs scenario. It was directed by Vincent McEveety, and stars Dean Jones "Dean Jones (actor)"), Sandy Duncan and Joe Flynn "Joe Flynn (US actor)"). The film was released on June 30, 1971, and received negative reviews from critics.
